channel.title: Insider Media Ltd - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Insider Media Ltd (insidermedia.com)

item.title: 'Great news for the West of England' - deep tech innovation organisation opens new office
item.description: Digital Catapult, the deep tech innovation organisation, has opened a new office for South Gloucestershire, Bristol and Bath.

item.title: Global cake stand manufacturer creates "first-of-its-kind" directory
item.description: A South West-based global cake stand manufacturer has created what it has branded a "first-of-its-kind" global directory of professional cake artists.

item.title: Birmingham Airport reveals financial incentive to attract direct US connectivity
item.description: Birmingham Airport has outlined a financial support package to airlines which aims to attract activity between the transport hub and New York.

item.title: Construction workloads in Wales continue to fall - RICS
item.description: Construction workloads in Wales fell through the final quarter of 2025, according to the latest Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors (RICS) Construction Monitor. However, surveyors are optimistic that workloads will pick up over the next year.

item.title: 'It’s fantastic to see such strong demand for these new units' - first tenants move in as new business park opens
item.description: The first businesses have now started moving into newly completed industrial units at a business park in Neath Port Talbot.

item.title: UK and US sign deal to bolster critical minerals supply chains
item.description: The UK and US have signed a partnership to secure supplies of critical minerals which power everyday essentials like smartphones and fridges.

item.title: Communications and tech firm expands into new Cardiff HQ - positions the company for its next phase of growth
item.description: A fast-growing communications and technology business has expanded into a new headquarters in Cardiff Bay.

item.title: Tech specialist reports growth as expansion plans begin to materialise
item.description: An Exeter-based technology specialist has recorded another year of growth amid increased demand.

item.title: Phenna Group continues flurry of deals with Italian buy
item.description: Phenna Group, an acquisitive testing, inspections, certification and compliance group based in Nottingham, has continued its flurry of M&A activity with its fourth deal this year.

item.title: Pre-tax profits hit £250m at Danske Bank UK as business lending passes milestone
item.description: Pre-tax profits have climbed to £250m at Danske Bank UK in a year when new lending approvals for NI business customers passed £1bn.
